Bing Maps business listings (category sweeps: dentist, orthodontist, chiropractor, physical therapy, pediatrician, optometrist, urgent care, therapist, hair/beauty/nail salon, barber, spa, martial arts, gym)

categories_thin: Med spas: no independent med spa found in North Brunswick itself; VIO Med Spa is a franchise and was excluded. Independent alternatives are massage and skin-care studios (Revive Spa, Lakeside, Ocean Spring, Divine Bliss, Blue Dream, Qi Qi).
Optometry: four small practices, all clustered on Route 27/Route 130; no further independent optometrists surfaced.

Counseling: only a few independent practices surfaced; several Suite 201 Old Georges Rd listings belong to LifeStance Health (excluded chain), which is why that address appears as a single merged entry.
Barbers: five independent shops now listed (the earlier draft's claim of only two was wrong); one more (EVIECUTS) is listed with no street number.
Nail salons: nine entries now, up from five; two 'Nail Fever' listings at different addresses may be one operator.
Dermatology and non-dental specialties: nothing independent remained after exclusions (Princeton Dermatology Associates has five offices plus a Penn Medicine affiliation).
caveats: Exclusion rule applied across the whole list: a brand with 5+ offices, or a practice owned by a regional/national network or hospital system, is treated as a chain and dropped. That removed Tender Smiles 4 Kids (6 offices), Garden State Smiles (5), Brighter Dental (5), Princeton Dermatology Associates (5 offices, Penn Medicine-affiliated) and Advocare (900+ providers). Practices with 2-4 offices in adjacent towns are retained and flagged in notes: KK Dental (3), Dubin Orthodontics (3), My Whole Child Pediatrics (2), Park Physical Therapy (2), AmeriDental (2).

Source quality: roughly 40 of these entries still cite a Bing Maps category query, which returns a different result set each run and cannot be re-checked per business. Where a stable page existed (DentistsRanked clinic profile, BestProsInTown profile, Gyms NJ listing, Fresha/Booksy, the practice's own site) the query URL was replaced. Medical and dental offices that only appear in map results still need a per-business listing check at triage.

Entries marked 'one directory profile only' or 'directory-only listing' (Zoyce, F&Y Chic, Belkys, D'Clase Doobie, villalona, Salon G and Spa, WEAR ME HAIR, David M. Potter DC, Healthquest Chiropractic, SpaKidz, EVIECUTS) need a status check before outreach.
Phone numbers left as 'Unknown' are ones no page I opened displayed; nothing was guessed.

Excluded as chains/franchises encountered this round: Great Expressions Dental (two North Brunswick listings), LifeStance/NJBH Therapies, European Wax Center, Club Pilates, CKO Kickboxing, F45 Training, Crunch, Planet Fitness, Retro Fitness, LA Fitness, UFC GYM, VIO Med Spa, Kessler Rehabilitation, JAG Physical Therapy, Twin Boro PT, Hand & Stone, Great Clips.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass was unreachable in the earlier pass (HTTP 406 and timeouts) and was not retried at length, so there is no OSM cross-check.

SalonLookup lists four further North Brunswick salons (LK Signature Salon, JAYBASH Beauty Lounge, SKIINAVE, AG Lash and Beauty Studio) but served no street addresses for them and I could not confirm them elsewhere, so they are not listed.

Barber Shop Directories lists unnamed barber shops at 672 Livingston Ave and 1846 US-1, and Nail Salon Directories lists an unnamed nail salon at 979 US-1; names never rendered, so they could not be entered.

New Horizons Physical Therapy's contact page did not render in extraction; the corrected address 620 Towne Center Dr is from the verifier's check of that page, and the practice's own site confirms only the North Brunswick 08902 title.
Hidden Lake Animal Hospital's address/phone (542 Shoppes Blvd, (732) 519-0021) come from its site's contact block, which extracted incomplete.

The 10-mile radius was not re-checked boundary by boundary; all entries sit in North Brunswick township, whose far corners may exceed 10 miles from central Milltown (inference from township size, not measured).
Several Route 1/Route 27/Route 130 offices sit near the New Brunswick line and could be split between towns in other zones.
